investment_theses.thesis: Stablecoin infrastructure (USDC, RLUSD) adoption by institutional finance will outperform crypto asset volatility, favoring USDC over USDT on regulatory arbitrage.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Robinhood backing Ripple's $2.5B RLUSD despite rival USDG; institutional stablecoin platforms multiplying
Cointelegraph: USDC overtaking USDT in euro trading post-MiCA; EU regulatory tailwind
CoinDesk: CF Benchmarks Wall Street pricing data onchain, BlackRock infrastructure adoption
investment_theses.counter_view: USDT dominance is entrenched (highest liquidity, deepest orderbooks); regulatory uncertainty in US (vs EU clarity) may favor Tether's agnosticism; Ripple RLUSD adoption signal overstated if adoption plateaus.
investment_theses.expression: Long USDC staking yield (e.g., Compound/Aave USDC APY) vs. short USDT perps or USDC/USDT basis trade; or directional bet: long Circle (if IPO) vs. short Tether equity if available

investment_theses.thesis: Tokenized index fund infrastructure (Stellar, Centrifuge, BlackRock data layer) will drive institutional capital inflow into onchain asset management; express via crypto largecap outperformance vs. tech equities.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Janus Henderson/Centrifuge Nasdaq-100 fund launch; Nasdaq-100 now onchain
CoinDesk: Intel, Oracle, IBM objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans (shows institutional friction, but also market demand)
CoinDesk: CF Benchmarks Wall Street pricing layer; BlackRock infrastructure investment
investment_theses.counter_view: Tokenized asset adoption remains niche; regulatory barriers (SEC custody, tax treatment) persist; institutional crypto AUM growth may be overstated if retail sells into strength.
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH (smart contract execution layer for fund infrastructure) + Long BTC (macro institutional risk-on signal); or long Ethereum relative to S&P 500 (ETH/SPY ratio); or delta-neutral long crypto largecaps, short NVDA (rotate AI hype from tech to crypto infrastructure)

investment_theses.thesis: Trade-war escalation (US–Canada auto tariffs, Trump tariff threats) will weigh on USD strength and equity valuations, boosting safe-haven assets (BTC, gold) and stablecoins as currency-hedges in emerging markets.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump threatened 50% tariffs on Canadian auto; Honda warns catastrophic impact
CoinDesk: Brazilian firms used stablecoins on election day (currency flight indicator)
BBC: Lula's Latin America comeback vs. Trump ambitions; geopolitical friction rising
investment_theses.counter_view: Tariff threats are negotiation posture; actual implementation delayed or watered down; Fed rate hold suggests USD weakness is priced in already; risk-on sentiment (JetBlue +20%, consumer resilience) may override trade war fears.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC + Long GLD (gold ETF) vs. short IWM (small-cap exposure to tariff-vulnerable companies); or long BTC/USD perps, short USD index (DXY) via USDT short (negative carry but directional hedge)

investment_theses.thesis: AI compute derivatives (FLOP, BitMEX AI contracts) will become a new institutional hedging instrument as crypto miners pivot to AI; BTC will decouple from AI-chip valuations (Nvidia) and trade more closely with compute infrastructure demand.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitcoin miners moving into AI, creating new market for compute power trading
CoinDesk: Hayes detailing FLOP AI compute derivatives vision
Hacker News: AI agent buildout (Genie 4, agent complexity discussions) signals growing AI infrastructure demands
investment_theses.counter_view: AI compute derivative markets are illiquid and nascent; Bitcoin's macro sensitivity (Fed policy, macro risk-on/risk-off) remains dominant; compute derivative trading could be a distraction trade with poor volume.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps + short NVDA (or XLK tech ETF); or long BTC/NVDA basis trade (long BTC spot, short NVDA forward); or long a crypto mining stock (e.g., MARA, RIOT) that's capturing AI capex pivot

CNBC: Fed expected to hold, Warsh flags future hike possibility; rate regime shift unlikely near-term
